snippet.title: FragPunk | Launch Preview Trailer - Coming Mar 6!
snippet.description:
#FragPunk Season 1: Wild Dawn is here! 💣🌆

Buckle up for 13 Lancers, 7 Maps, 16 Weapons, and 150+ Shard Cards. 

Are you ready to break the rules? See you on Mar 6, 2025! 🎮

Pre-order now! 👇
💣Xbox：https://www.xbox.com/games/store/fragpunk-pioneer-bundle/9PMLJZ8Z3WDX/0017
